full_judgment: 20. Besides, the defendant claimed that after getting the suit land from her father through the Heba-bil-ewaz deeds in question she got the suit jama mutated in her name and has been possessing the same since then and in support of this contention she has filed D.C.R., Khariji khatian and rent receipts marked Exts. Ghha-Uma and Cha. The said papers as exhibited by the defendant are important items of evidence of possession which may be used as collateral evidence of title since generally possession follows title which in respect of the suit land prima facie stands in favour of the defendant. In spite of the fact if the plaintiffs claim exclusive title to the suit land, they should have prayed for confirmation of possession but that having not been done the maintainability of the suit is called in question. Besides, D.Ws. 4 and 5 identifier and witness respectively of the disputed deeds have proved the execution of the deeds by the donor. D.W.6 was present when the said Heba-bil-ewaz deeds were executed by the donor. Moreso, D.Ws. 2 and 3 have deposed corroborating each other that the defendant has been in possession of the suit land.
